mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `s-seckill`.t_order_info (order_no, user_id, product_id, product_img, delivery_addr_id, product_name, product_count, product_price, seckill_price, status, create_date, seckill_date, seckill_time, intergral, seckill_id) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{productImg}, -1, #{productName}, #{productCount}, #{productPrice}, #{seckillPrice}, #{status}, NOW(), CURDATE(), #{seckillTime}, #{intergral}, #{seckillId})
INSERT INTO `s-seckill`.t_refund_log (out_trade_no, refund_time, refund_amount, refund_reason, refund_type) VALUES (#{outTradeNo}, NOW(), #{refundAmount}, #{refundReason}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE `s-seckill`.t_order_info SET status = 4, pay_date = NOW() WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT order_no, user_id, product_id, product_img, product_name, product_count, product_price, seckill_price, status, pay_type, create_date, pay_date, seckill_time, seckill_id, intergral FROM `s-seckill`.t_order_info WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId}
